scope: Assigned frozen titles and complete ItemBodies, local rendered HTML, and every assigned screenshot tile; no live routes.

review_method.normative_instructions: CLAUDE.md read fully; README.md read fully.
review_method.rendering: Every assigned local PNG tile was opened individually with tools.view_image at original resolution; no collage or downscaling.
review_method.source_snapshot_html: Every assigned frozen title and full ItemBody was reviewed in the snapshot and compared with current source, assigned HTML, capture receipt, and screenshot tiles.
review_method.boundary: No HTTP(S), live-site, or network access; no production source, application, library, or status edits; no builds, tests, gates, commits, or pushes. Only lane-01.md and lane-01.json were written.

findings.claim: The intended TikZ block is emitted literally as source text in the HTML/tile; receipt tikz_count is 0. The surrounding prose and raw commands are both visible, so this is not a crop or viewer artifact.

The same lower diagram is visible in the overlapping/context tile; source node coordinates and label placements explain the collision, so it is not a tile-boundary artifact.

existing_diagram_checks.check: The intended semantics are stated in lines 72-73. Current graph contains one state s, action nodes a and b, outgoing choice arrows, and probability-one self-return transitions with rewards 1 and 3; rendering has label overlap noted in findings. Shifted rewards 3 and 5 are described in prose and intentionally not shown.

Intended graph semantics are stated in lines 33-34; TikZ syntax is raw text because the block has no fence, so diagram semantics cannot be visually verified from a rendered graph. The source encodes supported s --a:1--> g, g --d:0--> g, and unsupported s --b:0 (learned b:1)--> s.

diagram_candidates.claim: The example states that each binary action string y of length n defines a depth-n policy tree and alpha_y(x,0)=sum_{t<n}1{x(t)=y(t)}; belief delta_(y,0) uniquely witnesses alpha_y at value n.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: For n=2 only, map the four hidden strings x∈{00,01,10,11} through clock states (x,0)→(x,1), annotate reward 1 exactly when action y_t matches x_t, and show point-mass belief delta_(y,0) selecting that tree with value 2 while the three other strings score at most 1. Label as a finite illustrative slice, not a proof of the general 2^n count; make clear witness beliefs need not be reachable from the specified initial belief.

diagram_candidates.claim: The procedure defines per-step ratios rho_{i,t}, prefix products W_{i,t}, full-horizon trajectory return G_i, then distinct OIS, PDIS, and self-normalized WIS formulas.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: A short trajectory S0,A0,R1,…,S_H with each rho_t on its action edge and W_t=product_{k≤t}rho_k above prefixes; below it align OIS using W_{H−1}G, PDIS summing gamma^t W_t R_{t+1}, and WIS as ratio of full-return weighted sums. Explicitly mark that WIS is self-normalized and no finite-sample unbiasedness claim is made. Optional and editorial because the formulas are already explicit.
